item.title: PM's visit bolsters Viet Nam's self-reliant economic development: Russian Deputy Minister
item.description: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh’s ongoing visit to Russia from March 22 to 25 is opening up opportunities to establish a solid infrastructure base for Viet Nam’s stable and self-reliant economic development, Russian Deputy Minister of Economic Development Vladimir Evgenievich Ilyichev told the Viet Nam News Agency.

item.title: Deputy PM chairs meeting of Steering Committee for Anti-Money Laundering
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ho Duc Phoc chaired a meeting of the Steering Committee for Anti-Money Laundering in Hanoi on March 24.

item.title: Deputy PM calls on US investors to cooperate in developing International Financial Centre
item.description: Standing Deputy Prime Minister Nguyen Hoa Binh on March 23 visited and held working sessions with NASDAQ and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), and attended a forum promoting investment in the Viet Nam International Financial Centre (VIFC).

item.title: Deputy FM hosts British Ambassador to advance ties
item.description: Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Dang Hoang Giang, who also serves as head of the ASEAN Senior Officials' Meeting (SOM) delegation of Viet Nam, hosted a reception for British Ambassador Iain Frew in Ha Noi on March 24 to discuss the ASEAN – UK cooperation and Viet Nam – UK ties.

item.title: Deputy PM sees promise in ties with Russia's Perm Krai
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ho Quoc Dung acknowledged the potential of cooperation between Vietnamese localities and Russia’s Perm Krai in processing industry, energy, chemicals, education – training, and people-to-people exchanges during a reception for Governor Dmitry Makhonin in Ha Noi on March 24.

item.title: PM attends Viet Nam – Russian Federation Business Forum in Moscow
item.description: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh attended the Viet Nam – Russian Federation Business Forum in Moscow on March 24, as part of his ongoing official visit to the European country.

item.title: Foreign Minister holds talks with European Commissioner for International Partnerships
item.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs Le Hoai Trung held talks with Jozef Sikela, European Commissioner for International Partnerships, in Ha Noi on March 24, expressing his hope for the Viet Nam – EU cooperation to be elevated in a more substantive and effective manner.

item.title: Prime Minister visits, works with Viet Nam's leading oil and gas partner in Russia
item.description: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh on March 24 afternoon (local time) visited and held a working session with leading officials of Zarubezhneft, a long-standing and leading partner of Viet Nam in the oil and gas sector, as part of his official visit to Russia.

item.title: PM Pham Minh Chinh meets with Chairman of Russian State Duma Vyacheslav Volodin
item.description: Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh had a meeting with Chairman of the Russian State Duma Vyacheslav Volodin and representatives of many political parties in the State Duma in Moscow on March 24 as part of his official visit to the European country.

item.title: Vietnamese Government leader meets with Secretary of Russian Security Council in Moscow
item.description: Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh met with Secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation Sergey Shoigu in Moscow on March 24, as part of his official visit to the European country.
